canonical_project: Shanghai LinkWise Surxondaryo Data Center (300 MW discussed)
owner: Shanghai LinkWise Data Intelligence Co., Ltd.
notes: Ministry of Energy MoU (2025-07-24) covers a 300 MW Bukhara data center with a similar 300 MW facility discussed for Surxondaryo (combined 600 MW program per ministry statements; Baxtel lists LinkWise: Surxondaryo planned for 2029). Weaker than the Bukhara MoU - no site within the region or construction start; planned lead only.
